scripts.build: tsc -b packages/shared packages/sandbox packages/agent packages/server apps/desktop && npm run build -w @bentomo/web
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/shared packages/sandbox packages/agent packages/server apps/desktop && npm run typecheck -w @bentomo/web
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test packages/sandbox/dist/test/*.test.js packages/agent/dist/test/*.test.js packages/server/dist/test/*.test.js packages/web/test/*.test.ts
scripts.dist:app: npm run build && npm run dist:mac-arm64-app -w @bentomo/desktop
